name: Work Station
description: A spot where a carried item is put down and taken back, and optionally worked on: hold F (or the phone's second button) to chop or wash it, or let it cook by itself, with a progress bar over it. Works with: Pickup Item.

changelog.notes: Initial release: put down and take back one carried item, hold-to-work and timed modes that turn one kind into another with a progress bar, combining two kinds, and station events a script reacts to by the station's Name.
The AI guide names genres in its examples, not a specific game.
